header:
Awesome Travel and Remote Work Tools

> Open-source tools for trip planning, maps, itineraries, expense splitting, offline use and remote teams. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Check visa and entry rules** on official government sites.
- **Download maps and tickets for offline use.**
- **Prices and hours change.** Confirm before you go.
- **Check the license.**

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). One entry per pull request, plain words, real sources only.
